text: Not any better than any other gamify app you can find.
author: Michael Sleigher
developer_reply:
We want to develop a simple and easy-to-use gamify app(exp, coin, shop and achievement) with the most practical and powerful to-do features like the subtask remind, picture attachments, list and count task type, etc. The gamify elements is not enough yet, but we'are planning to improve it. 
Finally, you can request refund at any time after a try.

text: I like the simplicity. I would like the ability to set start and end times more easily and be able to make block times like "this activity should take 2 hours" and be able to move them to naturally order themselves in time. Private groups would be nice. Would also like to be able to color code my daily activities. So if I can track things like balancing personal goals yellow for friends, blue for exercise etc. I love having experience and currency. Dark mode and widget are cool.
author: Underhillジン
developer_reply: Thanks for review! We will consider the block time setting. Currently you can move them in start time order by clicking the top-right menu "Sort", and then click the Start Time option. And we're planning to add color settings for tasks and lists. Thanks for advice again.

text: Downloaded earlier and so far I like it a lot. Nice clean design, yet detailed enough to be pretty and fun. Thoughtful use of color, and intuitive general organization of the app. Plus being able to set my own rewards makes a lot of sense. If I earn 300 points from getting my tasks completed, then I can have an hour of entertainment. It's like a visual way of managing my time and priorities to make sure I get the important stuff done first. Great for overwhelmed procrastinators like me👍☑️
author: A Google user
developer_reply: Thanks for review. Glad to hear that :) . We will continue to develop more features.

text: Pretty much what I needed! But there's still some rooms of improvement. Here are some of my thoughts: 1. Add the level of "Importance" instead of just urgency and difficulty. There are things which could be urgent but not so important, or both ugrent and important. I hope tasks that are both urgent and important can gain more coins from auto-calculation. 2. Allow custom punishment system. For example, the longer a task is overdued, the greater the punishment would be and max at 50% deduction.
author: A Google user
developer_reply:
Thanks for your rewiew and advice! We will continue making improvement ^ ^. 
For the first advice, actually, we are thinking of replacing the Urgency with Importance.
For the second one, there is already a simple custom punishment system that you can custom a fixed deduction. We're planning to improve it in the future.
